messages.author: 052cb554200cab3f
messages.subject: nimbleExternalCall boost c++ ode example
parts:
Hi All,
I am trying to get a toy example of using the boost odeint library with nimbleExternalCall() and I'm failing and not sure what the issue. I've tried lots of permutations. I'm using the help(nimbleExternalCall) example as a basis. The code is below. The error is 

asReturnSymbol(ode(x0, k, tend), type = "double", nDim = 0) :
could not find function "asReturnSymbol"

I have also attached a version which works in Rcpp, I basically want to drop this into nimble somehow as a compiled function (either directly in boost -as now- or via Rcpp).

thanks!
Fraser

#-------------- code 
rm(list=ls())
library(nimble)
## Not run:
sink('add1.h')
cat('
 
 extern "C" { double ode(double x0,double k, double tend);}

 #include <vector>
 typedef std::vector< double > state_type;

class f_ode {

    double m_k;

public:
    f_ode( double k ) : m_k(k) { }

    void operator() ( const state_type &x , state_type &dxdt , const double /* t */ )
    {
        dxdt[0] = - m_k*x[0];
    }
};

   
    ')
sink()
sink('add1.cpp')
cat('

#include "add1.h"
 #include <boost/numeric/odeint.hpp>  
 #include <iostream>

using namespace std;
    using namespace boost::numeric::odeint;
   
 double ode(double x0,double k, double tend) {
 
   
    state_type x(1);
    x[0] = x0; // start at x=1.0, p=0.0
   
   
    f_ode myf(k);
    size_t steps = integrate( myf ,
            x , 0.0 , tend , 0.1 );
   
    return(x[0]);
 
}
')
sink()
system('g++ add1.cpp -c -o add1.o -std=c++11')
Radd1 <- nimbleExternalCall(function(x0 = double(0), k = double(0),tend = double(0)){}, Cfun =  'ode',
headerFile = file.path(getwd(), 'add1.h'), returnType=double(0),
oFile = file.path(getwd(), 'add1.o'))
## If you need to use a function with non-scalar return object in model code,
## you can wrap it  in another nimbleFunction like this:
model_add1 <- nimbleFunction(
     run = function(x = double(0)) {
     #   ans <- numeric(length(x))
         nimPrint(Radd1(20.0, 0.5, 10.0))
         return(1.0)
         returnType(double(0))
     })
demoCode <- nimbleCode({
     for(i in 1:4) {x[i] ~ dnorm(0,1)} ## just to get a vector
     z<-model_add1(1.)
})


demoModel <- nimbleModel(demoCode, inits = list(x = rnorm(4)),
check = FALSE, calculate = FALSE)
CdemoModel <- compileNimble(demoModel, showCompilerOutput = TRUE)

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: nimbleExternalCall boost c++ ode example
parts:
Hi Fraser,

Thanks for the clear and reproducible example.  During model building, there is a step that tries to permanently evaluate what look like constants, such as model_add1(1.).  In the case of a nimbleExternalCall used from model_add1, this is causing the error.  I'll file an issue for that to be fixed and also covered in the test suite.

Meanwhile, please try

    y <- 1
     z<-model_add1(y)

That should avoid the constant evaluation step and works on my machine.

-Perry
